workspace.name: Business name
workspace.createDescription: Add a business, create an opening and review candidate CVs. Every member has the Recruiter role.
workspace.noBusinesses: You have not joined a business yet.
workspace.nameHint: Use the name candidates will recognise.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Follow CV intake and review candidates for an AI screening call.
overview.retained: Counts reflect retained records in this business. Rejected counts include recruiter-confirmed decisions only.
overview.intakeDescription: Retained CVs received during the last 30 days. Dates use IST.
overview.noData: CV activity will appear after an upload or a connected mailbox receives a CV.
overview.recruitmentFlow: Receive CVs. Find the right role. Run an AI screening call.

openings.title: Job openings
openings.description: Create jobs and manage the roles accepting CVs.
openings.emptyDescription: Start with a job title and description. Other details are optional.
openings.single: CVs are matched using the requirements you enter.
openings.closeDescription: This stops new CV intake for the opening. Its candidates, files and decisions remain available. Closed openings cannot be resumed.
openings.pausedHint: This opening is paused. CV emails received during the pause are skipped, including after you continue. Previously accepted CVs can finish processing.
openings.closedHint: This opening is closed. Its history is available for review.

setup.title: Job title
setup.automaticHint: Describe the work, required skills and preferred qualifications. The app creates its matching checklist from these details.
setup.fileLimits: PDF, DOCX or DOC. Up to five files per opening, 10 MB each.
setup.questionsHint: Save questions for later AI screening. Screening calls are not enabled yet.
setup.question: Question {{number}}

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Inspect profiles, match results and the CV passages behind them.
candidates.emptyDescription: Upload a CV to an opening or connect a recruitment inbox.
candidates.name: Candidate

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Check uncertain matches, processing failures and identity conflicts before deciding.
review.emptyDescription: Candidates who need a recruiter decision will appear here.
review.rejectionDescription: This records a final rejection and starts the business's rejection retention period. Review the CV and match before confirming.
review.confirmLabel: I reviewed the CV and confirm this rejection

future.interviewsDescription: Shortlisted candidates will choose a time for their AI screening call. Outlook will record the call time and prevent conflicting slots.
future.callsDescription: Sarvam will run English screening calls for suitable candidates. This page will show transcripts, recordings, technical scores and recruiter decisions.
future.interviewerDescription: Prepare role-specific questions, screening level and interview knowledge. Each call will use a published interview snapshot.
future.noCalls: No screening calls have been placed.
future.noInterviews: No screening interviews have been scheduled.
future.noInterviewer: Interviewer settings are not enabled in this release.

settings.title: Settings
settings.businessDescription: Your recruitment business and access details.
settings.teamDescription: Every member has the Recruiter role and can manage recruitment, membership and retention.
settings.retentionDescription: Choose how long candidate data remains available. Confirmed rejections and other workflows have separate deadlines.
settings.registeredHint: Add someone who already has a registered account. Email invitations are not enabled yet.
settings.removeDescription: They will lose access to this business. At least one recruiter must remain.
settings.retentionHint: Defaults are 7 days after confirmed rejection and 30 days for other workflows. Changes recalculate future deadlines.
settings.noEdit: The business timezone is fixed to India Standard Time.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Receive candidate CVs by email and prepare the services used for AI screening.
integrations.calendarDescription: Schedule AI screening calls and check calendar conflicts.
integrations.whatsappDescription: Contact shortlisted candidates and arrange their screening call.
integrations.telephonyDescription: Connect your own telephony account and verified Indian caller ID for Sarvam screening.
integrations.notAvailable: This integration is not enabled yet.

authSetup.forgotDescription: Request a secure link for your Frontdesk account.
authSetup.deliveryUnavailable: Account email delivery is not configured. Ask your administrator to enable recovery and verification emails.
authSetup.inviteUnavailable: Email invitations are not enabled yet. Create an account and ask a recruiter to add your account ID to the business.
authSetup.invalidLink: This link is missing or invalid.
authSetup.resetSuccess: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
authSetup.recoverySent: If the account is eligible, a recovery email will arrive.
